preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and stdin.strip() == stdin and all(c in '0123456789' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of digits (0-9) with no leading/trailing whitespace.
The length of the digit sequence is between 1 and 100,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: stdout is a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of jumps.
The output is the minimal number of jumps required to go from the first digit (stdin[0]) to the last digit (stdin[-1]) using allowed moves (adjacent indices or any index with the same digit value).
